title: KhmerReviewer
description: Schema for one entry in data/reviewers.json, the roster of people allowed to appear in provenance.reviewedBy.

handle.description: GitHub username. This exact value is what goes in a term's provenance.reviewedBy (matched case-insensitively).

level.description: community: counts toward community-reviewed. expert: native linguist, professional translator, or domain specialist who may set expert-reviewed and verified in their domains.

domains.description: Domains this reviewer covers. Values must be in the domain enum of term.schema.json.

joined.description: Date added to the roster, YYYY-MM-DD.
